# clear-goals

Kind: Git repo.
The seed is an approved vision, an authoritative design and settled domain terms with no open decisions.
There is no intentionally broken source or check.
Serves AC-6, AC-8, AC-10 and AC-38 as evidence for later discovery and recommendations without repeating the interview.
The registry declares two dated commits: approval of the vision, then design and vocabulary.
`node sanity.mjs <built-folder>` requires Node 24 or later and Git and checks the documents and clean history.
